CosmoStructureGrowth.title: Finite structure-growth relation
CosmoStructureGrowth.statement: Structure growth is deterministic evolution of a finite source-density distinction network under locally forced interaction and expansion relations; weights describe unresolved initial/history fibres rather than ontic randomness.
CosmoStructureGrowth.generation_rule: Generate the complete emission, propagation, observation-time, source/response, provenance, target-access, successor and extra-rule product.
CosmoStructureGrowth.grammar_boundary: All finite cosmological-boundary forms generated from exact source-bound propagation, recurrence ratios, causal paths and observation records; astronomical census and historical initial conditions remain outside this Physics closure.

CosmoStructureGrowth.exact_result: Cosmic structure growth is finite deterministic Fold network evolution under registered gravitational and expansion relations.
CosmoStructureGrowth.induction_base: One source event emits one recurrence carrier along one generated causal path to one observation event.
CosmoStructureGrowth.induction_step: Adding one source, path cell or observation preserves every prior emission, recurrence, causal and detector record and appends exactly its generated relations.

floating, irrational, imaginary or signed proof magnitude
